title: Lester Nelson and the ages of the tenor men
summary: He praises tenor man Lester Nelson's rolling style and compares his age with Miller's.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Well what about Lester Nelson? We were talking about him a minute ago.

Nelson, yeah. He was a fine tenor man. I say he was one of the best tenor men around him. And that was before Miller's time. Of course Miller got the credit later on. But I said Lester could outplay any of these fellas. And he played a nice style. And a likable style. He had a kind of a rolling style. He didn't tongue his notes. He just slaughtered them. It just came out from the heart I'd say.
Yeah, he was around my age. Well he was a little bit younger than me I think. But older than Miller? Older than Miller, yeah. More than in Charlie Cordillo's class?
No, not that old. But between that. You see I think Miller's around in his forties now. I think fifties now.
